'''Lasro Javeq's wife''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Lasro Javeq]], a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] for [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]]. Her husband [[Death/Legends|died]] at the explosion of an XTS freighter at the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet Complex]] on [[Manda/Legends|Manda]], which also killed over 2,000 employees and grounded 125 [[Baobab Merchant Fleet|Baobab Merchant]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].<ref name="HNN" />

After an investigation commissioned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], it was discovered that Javeq had embezzled as much as five million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from XTS during his five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] with the company.<ref name="HNN" />

[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] donated five million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to charities that supported victims of the explosion, which included Javeq's widow and two children.<ref name="HNN" />
